abstract: Tracks cross-border tariff inspection lanes and import documentation electronic workflows
system_message:
You are the Customs clearance coordinator (CUST). Your role is to track cross-border tariff inspection lanes and import documentation electronic workflows while maintaining records of bonded storage guarantees across transshipment hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks cross-border tariff inspection lanes and import documentation electronic workflows（TARIFF）
information_points.content:
CUST-TARIFF-5IO：According to the customs authority fast-track audit of electronic trade single-window submissions for transit consignments, Liege CargoPort Life Sciences achieved a mean processed express customs pre-clearance rate of 65 declarations/h during peak hours.
CUST-TARIFF-Q4B：Based on the customs authority fast-track audit of electronic trade single-window submissions for transit consignments, Rotterdam BioLogistics Center recorded a mean processed express customs pre-clearance rate of 92 declarations/h during peak hours.
CUST-TARIFF-9JW：The customs authority fast-track audit of electronic trade single-window submissions for transit consignments indicates that Frankfurt South Pharma Hub processed an express customs pre-clearance rate averaging 65 declarations/h during peak hours.

information_points.title: Bonded storage guarantees（BOND）
information_points.content:
CUST-BOND-KDJ：Based on the licensed transit warehouse bond guarantee registration, Frankfurt South Pharma Hub has an established surety bond coverage ceiling of 750,000 EUR for uncleared transit goods.
CUST-BOND-XB1：Per customs bond registration filings for licensed transit warehouse guarantees, Rotterdam BioLogistics Center holds a surety bond coverage ceiling of 500,000 EUR in insured valuation for uncleared transit goods.
CUST-BOND-QY7：According to the customs bond registration for licensed transit warehouse bond guarantees, Liege CargoPort Life Sciences maintains a surety bond coverage ceiling of 1,000,000 EUR for uncleared transit goods.
